title: ReportResult
description: A finished report result, as `report.run` returns it.

report.description: The template and saved configuration that produced it.

title.description: The document title (`gnc:html-document-set-title!`): the HTML `<title>` and, without a headline, the heading.

headline.description: A heading when it differs from the title (`gnc:html-document-set-headline!`).

now.description: The time the report was run for.

options.description: Every option's value, in wire form, so the result says exactly what produced it.

log.description: The report log: what the script printed.

export.description:
The rows of the report's export, when the run was for an export the template offers (`report.exportCsv`):
GnuCash's export string before it is joined (`gnc:html-document-set-export-string`). Absent otherwise.

exportError.description:
Why the run for an export has nothing to export, as the script gave it (`gnc:html-document-set-export-error`,
`5.17:gnucash/report/trep-engine.scm:2524`): "No splits found". Absent otherwise.

css.description:
The report's own CSS, which a page appends after the style sheet's (`gnc:html-document-set-style-text!`,
`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/invoice.scm:795`) (v0.6). Never text the CSS template refuses
(`design/reports.md` §8): the host leaves that out and says so in the log. Absent when the report sets none.

ReportIdentity.description: The report a result came from.

configuration.description: The saved report configuration's GUID, when one was run.

Section.description: A section: an optional title and ordered blocks.

Block.description: A block of a section, told apart by `kind`.

link.description:
Something the text leads to, such as the Multicolumn statements' "Barchart" report
(`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/balsheet-pnl.scm:1079-1083`).

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

oneOf.description: A warning (`gnc:html-make-generic-warning` and those built on it, `5.17:gnucash/report/html-utilities.scm:350-381`).

title.description: The warning's title, such as "No accounts selected".

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

rows.description: The rows; each has one cell per column, counting spans.

footnotes.description:
Notes that cells mark with a `footnote` number, numbered from 1 and listed after the table: GnuCash's footnote
collector (`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/budget.scm:240-259`).

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

grid.description: Grid lines (`set-grid?!`); on by default, as in GnuCash's chart (`:236-239`).

labels.description: Category labels (bar, line) or slice labels (pie).

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

oneOf.description: Blocks laid out side by side: the one-row layout tables of the two-column Balance Sheet and Income Statement.

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).
Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

oneOf.description: A Multicolumn View's children in rows of cells (`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/view-column.scm:51-159`).

width.description: The view's "Number of columns", GnuCash's `table-width`: the width at which a row is closed.

rows.description: The rows, top to bottom. A cell spanning rows takes room in the rows below without being listed in them.

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

oneOf.description:
A picture, the invoice's `picture` layout choice (`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/invoice.scm:300-308`)
(v0.6).

src.description:
The picture's address: `file:///` and the file name, as `make-file-url` writes it. Always starts `file:///`,
so a page never fetches anything from the network.

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

oneOf.description: Set by the host only: the options that differ from their defaults (`gnc:html-render-options-changed`).

rows.description: One row per changed option, in option order.

TextRole.description: The role of a text block.

Link.description:
Something a client can open, as GnuCash's anchors (`5.17:gnucash/report/html-utilities.scm:82-128`): an account,
split or transaction in a register, an invoice, a price, a linked document, or another report, GnuCash's
drill-down (`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/category-barchart.scm:589-609`). GnuCash makes a report instance
for a report link at render time; red-ale only describes it, and a client runs it.

oneOf.description: `{ "split": "<guid>" }`: the split in its account's register (`gnc:split-anchor-text`, `:90-91`).
`{ "price": "<guid>" }`: a price in the price database (`gnc:price-anchor-text`, `:107-110`).

`{ "docLink": "<uri>" }`: a transaction's or invoice's linked document (`gnc:transaction-doclink-anchor-text`,
`:96-100`). Described only: a page shows its text unlinked, so an exported page points at no file.

ReportLink.description: A link to a report run.

configuration.description: A saved configuration of the template to run (v0.5); `options` are then changes over its values.

options.description: The options to change, in the form `report.run` takes.

align.description: Alignment; amounts default to the right.

levels.description:
For an `amount` column of an account table: the staircase positions, a deeper account's amount further left
and totals furthest right (`5.17:gnucash/report/html-acct-table.scm:870-923`).

labelLines.description:
The heading as stacked lines, top first, when it takes several header rows: GnuCash's multi-row column headers
(`gnc:html-table-set-multirow-col-headers!`, `5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/txn-columns.scm:170-174`).
`label` still names the column for a client that reads one line.

account.description: The account the row is about.

depth.description: Indentation of the label, in levels (`indented-depth`, `5.17:gnucash/report/html-acct-table.scm:749-763`).

level.description: The amount's staircase position, 0 being the rightmost.

alternate.description:
For a `data` or `account` row: whether it is shaded as GnuCash's `alternate-row` (`true`) or `normal-row`
(`false`). Absent, rows alternate by position. The Transaction Report shades by split and keeps a
transaction's lines alike (`5.17:gnucash/report/trep-engine.scm:1967-1977`).

cells.description: The cells, `null` for an empty one.

RowRole.description:
What a row is. The roles stand for GnuCash's row and cell markup (`primary-subheading`, `total-label-cell`,
`total-number-cell`), which style sheets colour.

oneOf.description: A grand total: "Total Liabilities & Equity", "Net income".
A horizontal rule across the table (`gnc:html-table-append-ruler!`).

A warning inside a table, shown bold and in the negative colour: Investment Lots' warning rows
(`total-label-cell neg`, `5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/investment-lots.scm:1077-1096`).

Cell.description:
A cell. It holds exactly one of `text`, `monetary`, `commodities`, `number`, `price`, `date` and `anchors`; the
display fields are filled in by the host.

commodities.description:
GnuCash's nested commodity table: one line per commodity an account holds, with its value in the report
currency (`5.17:gnucash/report/html-acct-table.scm:925-948`).

number.description: A plain number, such as a percentage.

price.description: A price or exchange rate in `currency`.

anchors.description:
Pieces of text, each linked, shown one per line: the Transaction Report's invoice cell
(`5.17:gnucash/report/trep-engine.scm:1036-1049`).

until.description: For a `date`: the end of the period it starts, shown `<date> to <until>`.

suffix.description: For a `number`: text after the figure, such as `" %"`.

rounding.description: For a `number`: how it is rounded to `places`; banker's when absent.

numberFormat.description: For a `number`: how it is printed; GnuCash's number renderer when absent.

currency.description: For a `price`: the currency it is in.

rounded.description: Host: for a `monetary`, the amount at the commodity's SCU, banker's rounding.

localDate.description: Host: for a `date`, its local date `YYYY-MM-DD` in the run's time zone.

localUntil.description: Host: for a `date` with `until`, the local date of `until`.

display.description: Host: the figure as text, for `monetary`, `number`, `price` and `date` cells; `<date> to <until>` for a period.

account.description: The account the cell names or links to.

rule.description:
An accounting rule above the figure ("Show accounting-style rules",
`5.17:gnucash/report/html-acct-table.scm:901-906`).

footnote.description: The number of the table's footnote this cell refers to, shown as a superscript after the content.

class.description: Class names added to the cell's own, for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

Monetary.description: An exact amount of one commodity. On the wire: `{ "amount": Rational, "commodity": "CURRENCY::USD" }`.

Rational.description: An exact rational of any size, reduced, with a positive denominator. Never a JSON number.

converted.description: Its value in the report currency, when converted.

display.description: Host: the native amount as text.

convertedDisplay.description: Host: the converted value as text.

Anchor.description: One linked piece of text in an `anchors` cell.

NumberRounding.description: How a `number` cell is rounded to its `places`.

oneOf.description: Ties to even, as GnuCash's number renderer rounds (`5.17:gnucash/report/html-style-info.scm:233-236`).

Ties away from zero, as Guile's `~,nf` rounds the rates GnuCash prints from doubles
(`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/advanced-portfolio.scm:914-922`).

GnuCash's share print info (`gnc_share_print_info_places`, `5.17:libgnucash/app-utils/gnc-ui-util.cpp:1013-1023`):
exactly `places` decimals, rounded half away from zero (`:1105-1145`), grouped with the locale's numeric
separators, the decimal point always printed: the portfolios' share counts, `100.` with no places.

`xaccPrintAmount` with `gnc_default_print_info(FALSE)` (`5.17:libgnucash/app-utils/gnc-ui-util.cpp:833-860`):
at least the Locale's `frac_digits` decimals, no maximum and no rounding, grouped, a remainder that is not a
decimal as `w + n/d`. The invoice's quantities and percentage discounts
(`5.17:gnucash/report/html-style-info.scm:217-218`) (v0.6). Takes no `places` and no `rounding`.

PlotSize.description: A plot size: GnuCash's `(percent . n)` or `(pixels . n)` (`5.17:bindings/guile/gnc-optiondb.i:1094-1108`).

oneOf.description: A percentage of the space available.

label.description: The axis label; empty for none.

scale.description: How positions are laid out; `category` for bar and line, `linear` for scatter, by default.

Scale.description: How axis positions are laid out.

AxisFormat.description: How values on an axis show.

values.description: One value per label, `null` for none; every chart but `scatter`.

colors.description: One colour per value: a pie's slices.

fill.description: Fill the area under a line, or fill a bar.

stack.description: Series with the same stack name stack together.

kind.description: Draw this series as bars or a line, to mix them.

link.description: A link for the whole series.

line.description: For `scatter`: join the points with a line of this colour (`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/price-scatter.scm:269-274`).

pointRadius.description:
The points' radius, GnuCash's `pointRadius` (`5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/balance-forecast.scm:153-154`):
0 hides a line's markers, which keep their hover labels; any other radius draws them as usual.

displays.description: Host: each value as its hover label shows it, under the y axis's format.

Point.description: A point of a scatter series.

display.description: Host: y as its hover label shows it.

SeriesKind.description: How a series is drawn when a chart mixes them.

grouped.description: One label for all series at a category; GnuCash's default `index` mode (`:220-221`).

nonZeroOnly.description: Leave zero values out of the label.

account.description: The account the item names, which links to its register (`gnc:html-account-anchor`).

rowspan.description: The rows the cell spans, 0 to 100, GnuCash's `high`.

colspan.description: The columns the cell spans, 0 to 100, GnuCash's `wide`; a page shows 0 as 1.

child.description: The child's position in the view's report-list, from 0.

link.description:
*Host*: a report link that runs the child alone, GnuCash's "Single Report"; absent when the child names no
report that is loaded.

warning.description: *Host*: why the child did not run, in place of `result`: GnuCash's "Report error".

EmbeddedResult.description:
A child's report result: what `report.run` returns, without the view's `version` and `now`, and without its `css`,
which a page holding several reports leaves out (`design/reports.md` §8).

report.description: The template and saved configuration run.

title.description: The child's title, which a page shows as the cell's heading.

headline.description: A heading when it differs from the title.

options.description: Every option's value, in wire form.

LogEntry.description: An entry of the report log.

source.description: The script it came from, when known.

LogLevel.description: The call that wrote a log entry.

title.description: The warning's title, such as "No accounts selected".

class.description: Class names for the report's CSS (`css`), separated by single spaces (v0.6).

OptionsSummaryRow.description: One changed option in the options summary.

section.description: The option's section; empty for a view's `Embedded Report` rows (v0.5), which name no option.

value.description: Its value as text; for an `Embedded Report` row, the child's "Report name".

ExportCell.description: One cell of an export row; `null` for an empty one.

anyOf.description: An exact number, written as Guile prints it once inexact.
